items.en_title: Santana do Acaraú (CE) Supplies & equipment procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 24 #1211.41/2025
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Santana do Acaraú (CE) is procuring supplies, equipment or consumables through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 5,597,432; proposals close Nov 24, 23:59 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
